name: x64/FFXII_TZA_GameSetting.exe
what_it_does: the launcher (.NET); every other row is decompiled from it

name: Language
value_or_text: en, de, fr, it, kr, es, cn, ch or jp: the Steam game language when it is one of the nine, else the value read, else the one GetUserDefaultLangID gives
what_it_does: picks the SettingsLoc.xml Lang element and its font; after a save the in-memory language is the key's value, default us; game: the game's Language setting

name: DeviceID
value_or_text: the chosen adapter's DXGI device id, set in memory at every change of the adapter box and at save time
what_it_does: with LUIDLow, LUIDHigh and Monitor picks the adapter box item by text comparison and, through Convert.ToInt32, the output whose modes are listed; a non-number takes the adapter with the most dedicated video memory (the FormatException is caught), a number outside 32 bits raises an OverflowException that is not caught; game: the game's DeviceID setting

name: LUIDLow
value_or_text: the low 32 bits of the adapter's LUID, (int)(luid << 32 >> 32)
what_it_does: as DeviceID; game: the game's LUIDLow setting

name: LUIDHigh
value_or_text: always 0: (int)(luid >> 32 << 32) keeps only bits that the cast to int drops
what_it_does: as DeviceID; the comparison uses the same expression, so 0 matches; game: the game's LUIDHigh setting

name: Monitor
value_or_text: the output's 1-based index on its adapter
what_it_does: as DeviceID; with the adapter matched, 0 or a negative value indexes Outputs[-1] or lower, which throws an exception that is not caught; game: the game's Monitor setting

name: FrameLimit
value_or_text: 30 or 60, set in memory by the box at every change and at save time
what_it_does: 60 selects 60FPS; any other value, the missing-key default 30FPS included, selects 30FPS; with 60 the resolution list keeps only modes of 59 Hz or more; game: the game's FrameLimit setting

name: ScreenMode
value_or_text: SM_WINDOW, SM_FULLSCREEN, SM_BORDERLESS (set in memory by the box at save time)
what_it_does: missing or a value outside the three: the box selects SM_FULLSCREEN (SetComboBoxSelected with defaultKey SM_FULLSCREEN); the mode picks the resolution list and enables the adapter box only in full-screen mode; game: the game's ScreenMode setting

name: Quality
value_or_text: VQ_LOW, VQ_MEDIUM, VQ_HIGH, VQ_CUSTOM, or a value outside them unchanged
what_it_does: missing: VQ_MEDIUM; a value outside the four item keys is added as an item with that key and the text Custom, so a save writes it back unchanged; game: the game's Quality setting

name: VSync
value_or_text: On, Off or Adaptive, set in memory by the box at every change and at save time
what_it_does: Off and Adaptive select their items; any other value, a missing key included, selects on; game: the game's VSync setting

name: MasterVolume
what_it_does: int.Parse in LoadConfiguration: a non-number throws while the window loads; game: no MasterVolume key in the game's 31-key table: 0x001DE5D0 logs [ConfigFile] invalid key

name: WindowSize
value_or_text: the selected size, only when windowed mode is selected; the save turns each x into * (1280*720)
what_it_does: the read turns each * into x; windowed mode: a value below 640x360 is raised to it and inserted in size order when the list lacks it, an exact text match is selected, else the item nearest in pixel count; missing: the first item; a value with no * makes the Substring arithmetic throw; game: the game's WindowSize setting, width*height

name: Resolution
value_or_text: the selected size, only when full-screen mode is selected; the save turns each x into * (1920*1080)
what_it_does: the read turns each * into x; full-screen: an exact text match is selected, else the item nearest in pixel count; missing: the last item; borderless: listed only when Screen.AllScreens is empty (default the primary screen's size); game: the game's Resolution setting, width*height

name: Mute
value_or_text: Off: mIsMute changes only in pictureBox2_Click, which no control has as a handler
what_it_does: never read; game: no Mute key in the game's 31-key table: 0x001DE5D0 logs [ConfigFile] invalid key

name: LastX
what_it_does: borderless mode: the screen containing (LastX, LastY) gives the listed size, else the screen whose bottom-right corner is nearest, measured with LastX on both axes; a non-number throws; game: the game's LastX setting

name: LastY
what_it_does: borderless mode: used only in the containment test of LastX; game: the game's LastY setting

name: Volume
value_or_text: never written: no code passes the key Volume to SetIniString
what_it_does: SetIniString would call OnVolumeChanged, which nothing assigns; game: no Volume key in the game's 31-key table
